senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. תָּעָה) [to move to and fro,] to sport, trifle. Mekh. Bo, s. 13 מוציאין … ומְתַעְתְּעִין בהן they (the dogs) dragged their first-born out of their graves and sported with them; Pesik. Vayhi, p. 65ᵃ; Yalk. Ex. 186 ומתעדנין (corr. acc.).
units: <cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 10:1">Midr. Prov. to X, 17</cite> (ref. to <he>מתעה</he> <cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 10:1">ib.</cite>) <he>כל תלמיד חכם … מְתַעְתֵּעַ במי וכ׳</he> a scholar that neglects the words of the Law is to be considered as one that trifles with him who spoke and the world arose; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 946">Yalk. Prov. 946</cite>.
